claim: Do not idle for the raster before every buffer flip; defer in-between flips into the next view's geometry loop and flip from a check inside it once the raster has left the view.

evidence.text: Speed pass: in-between flips deferred into the next view's object loop (flipchk); views per redraw rose 6.67 to 7.46 (+11.8%), pace median +0.69; the flip's line and raster are checked in the simulator.
